target_customer: Overweight and chronic disease risk consumers in Indonesia who pay a subscription for coaching
problem: People in Indonesia struggle to change eating habits that drive obesity, diabetes and other chronic disease, and have little access to certified nutritionists.
business_model: Consumer subscription for nutritionist chat coaching, later adding doctor consultations and medication delivery
product_category: Digital health coaching and metabolic clinic

founders.name: Rifanditto Adhikara
founders.background_notes: Listed as Ditto R on the YC page (product and growth). The YC page and press list no prior employers or education for him individually.

founders.name: Dito Krista
founders.background_notes: YC page: led insurtech business strategy at OVO.

technical_complexity.rationale: A coaching app with chat and subscription billing is standard engineering; the hard part was operations, recruiting certified nutritionists and retaining users, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Coaching apps are easy to copy and the vetted nutritionist network is the only asset; no data or regulatory moat was cited in sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it. Later sources show Halodoc launching a weight management clinic (Halofit), which was dated after the batch.

market_need_then: YC pitched it as Noom for Southeast Asia. The YC page and the seed coverage describe a need for chronic disease prevention through eating habits, but no dated demand statistics were found.

branding.domain_note: Started on sirka.io and now redirects to sirka.co.id (seen in a fetch of the site, 2026).

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: The current site uses friendly, informal Indonesian.

brand_strength.rationale: Only company claims and funding coverage exist; no press about the brand itself, no community or virality evidence.

pivots.to: Metabolic clinic with doctor consultations, GLP-1 and other medications, and home delivery
pivots.why: The seed coverage said it planned to add medications and supplies for chronic conditions; the current site shows the clinic model. Exact date not found.

outcome_analysis: Sirka raised a 2.6 million dollar seed in February 2022 with Sequoia, YC and regional investors and remains active. Reported user numbers conflict (7,000 active subscribers on one page, more than 10,000 paying out of 100,000 users in 2024 coverage) and no later round was found. It has moved from pure coaching toward a doctor-led metabolic clinic, which suggests coaching alone was not the whole business.
notes: Competitors: searches for rivals dated near the 2021 batch found none; Halodoc Halofit and Kalg.ai appeared only in later results, so the list is empty. A Sep 2021 Tech in Asia item (Sequoia and YC joining a round) and a DailySocial item on a follow-on round of 37 billion rupiah appear in search snippets but the amounts were not opened and are not recorded as rounds. Aggregators give total raised 2.73M (CB Insights) and an enterprise value of 10 to 16M (Dealroom), both unverified. Subscriber counts are undated and conflict. The YC page lists the CEO as Ditto R; press names Rifanditto Adhikara as CEO.
